page.overview:
Who is Miss Bishop?

Miss Bishop is a librarian that is featured in the Goro, Prince of Pain trilogy within the Mortal Kombat comic books.

Miss Bishop herself accompanies Abacus in the Library of Order and endlessly assists him in maintaining the occurrences of the universe.
